"""Main-owned finite publication and creation of an isolated Monitor implementation worktree."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl, hashlib, importlib.util, json, traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-latest-updates-20261012')
G = W.parent.parent
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-consolidated'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('update_merge_pub_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin',
           HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',
           GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -o BatchMode=yes')
old = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())
for key in ('RUBYLIB', 'GEM_PATH'):
    ENV[key] = old['environment'][key]

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-update-recheck-merge-publication-root-v2'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], gpu_executed=False, environment=ENV,
             source={'path': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': m.sha(Path(__file__))})
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    def run(label, args, cwd=W, wall=180):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, args, ENV, cwd, wall=wall, cpu=wall * 4, rss_cap=8 << 30,
                             text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
        return so.read_text().strip()
    try:
        for name in ('main-update-recheck-integration-root-v1', 'main-update-recheck-server-cpu-root-v1',
                     'main-update-recheck-server-lints-root-v1'):
            v = json.loads((B / name / 'record.json').read_text())
            assert v['passed'] and v['complete'] and not v['active']
        run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh',
                             *[str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]])
        run('diff-check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--check', 'HEAD'])
        run('stage-report', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit-merge', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m',
                            'feat(serve): consolidate v0.1.43 server updates with tuning branch'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push-merge', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'sync/latest-updates-20261012'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        child = G / '.worktree/sync-v0143-monitor-cache-20261012'
        assert not child.exists()
        run('create-monitor-worktree', ['/usr/bin/git', 'worktree', 'add', '-b',
                                        'sync/v0143-monitor-cache-20261012', str(child), r['commit']], cwd=G)
        run('verify-worktrees', ['/usr/bin/git', 'worktree', 'list', '--porcelain'], cwd=G)
        r['implementation_worktree'] = str(child)
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'complete', 'error', 'commit', 'implementation_worktree')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
